name: plan-start-statin-is-not-current
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Problem List:
  Hyperlipidemia
A/P: Plan: start atorvastatin 40 mg nightly.
note: A drug the plan intends is not a drug the patient is taking. 'On statin' feeds both the risk model and the guideline pathway, so a planned statin read as current understates what the visit still needs to do.

name: will-start-antihypertensive
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
A/P: will start lisinopril 10 mg daily

name: candidate-for-statin
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Patient is a candidate for atorvastatin therapy.
note: Being a candidate is the opposite of being on it.

name: failed-statin-therapy
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Failed atorvastatin and rosuvastatin due to myalgias.
note: Failed therapy is not current therapy.

name: declined-statin
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Discussed statin; patient declined rosuvastatin.

name: started-past-tense-is-current
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Medications:
  atorvastatin 40 mg, started 2019
note: Tense is the whole distinction: 'start atorvastatin' is a plan, 'started atorvastatin' is a current medication. The guard must not swallow this one.

text:

name: plan-to-stop-still-on-it-today
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Medications:
  lisinopril 20 mg daily
A/P: plan to stop lisinopril

name: orders-placed-are-not-results
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Orders placed: Hemoglobin A1c, lipid panel
note: An ordered test has no result yet.

name: hyphen-compound-mdrd-4-variable
note: A number bonded to a word by a hyphen is part of that word. This was giving an eGFR of 4.

name: hyphen-compound-25-hydroxyvitamin
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
25-hydroxyvitamin D 32
Total chol 198
HDL 51
note: Same rule keeps a vitamin D assay name out of the lipids.

name: then-now-was-and-now
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI was 33, now 27.4
note: In a then/now pair the current value is the second one.

name: then-now-increased-from-to
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI increased from 28.1 to 31.4 over 2 years
note: The same shape written as from/to.

name: historical-clause-loses-to-current
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
LDL 160 three months ago; LDL today 98
note: A clause that says outright the value is old ('three months ago') yields to a current one.

name: historical-year-loses-to-current
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Total chol 265 in 2024; total chol 198 today
note: 'in 2024' marks the first value as historical.

name: baseline-parenthetical-still-ignored
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Total chol 198 (baseline 265)
HDL 51
note: A prior value in a parenthetical was already handled and must stay handled.

name: donor-creatinine-is-not-the-patients
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Donor creatinine was 0.8 at time of transplant
Cr 1.4
note: A transplant donor's labs sit in the chart beside the patient's. Using the donor's 0.8 gave an eGFR of 103 instead of 58 - a healthy kidney where there is impairment.

name: fetal-measurements-are-not-the-patients
text:
Age: 32
Sex: Female
Fetal heart rate 140
Estimated fetal weight 2800 g
BP 118/72
BMI 26.1
note: Obstetric charts carry a second set of numbers belonging to the fetus.
